prior_factual_result.interpretation: P20 correct reward credit important but reward-only acquisition unreliable; masked-history P20 relies on privileged teacher labels. Neither established native hybrid superiority.

question: Can the original token-free GRU learn useful chronological action/outcome history from its OWN factual source actions and rewards, with velocity sensors masked, and reproducibly outperform separately reward-trained same-parameter single-observation and two-observation GRUs?
null: Full-history 489-parameter GRU fails reward-only acquisition on any initialization, fails paired same-budget gains over learned current-only/two-frame controls, or fails trained reward-credit negative discrimination. A performance tie with finite-difference control is not architectural superiority.

observations.mask_applied: after every factual reset and step, before any policy trains or evaluates, for ALL masked arms and strong finite-difference control
observations.factual_previous_action_reward: last ACTUALLY executed action and last OBSERVED reward only; no future or expert action labels

study.current_only_control: Same GRU input [8,6] with previous 7 rows zeroed in BOTH training and evaluation; separately trained; no evaluation-only distribution shift.
study.two_frame_control: Same GRU input [8,6] with previous 6 rows zeroed in BOTH training and evaluation; separately trained; same parameter count and forward shape.
study.wrong_credit_control: Same masked full-history 489-parameter GRU; preserve TRUE reward critic targets and rotate action GAE time32 and env1 only.
study.all_arms_same_ppo_algorithm: Unmodified source-pinned P20 clipped PPO and GAE: AdamW .0015, gamma .99, lambda .95, entropy .015, critic .5, clip .2, grad_clip 1, 3 epochs, minibatch 256.
study.train_seeds: For each on-policy slot j, reset at 84000+1000*j+completed_episode_count; same seed rule but naturally divergent realized trajectories
study.training_determinism: Source-pinned CPU torch single-thread, independent per-arm seeded sampling, no package install, no model inheritance, no P20 evaluation reseeding
study.forbidden: No P20 dev train/eval seeds reused; no P20 trained weights, P19 expert labels, privileged velocity for masked arms, future outcomes, source step modifications, scientific first-use or sealed unseen environments

required_evidence.test_budget_stop: On source violation, protected science admission failure, nonfinite train or failed regressions STOP before factual dev run; max experiment 600s; preserve null and partial receipts

acceptance.engineering_pass: Source and exact-SHA custody, full regressions, controls and receipt validity only
acceptance.development_support: Frozen rule all 3 initializations and strongest control comparisons reported
